subject: Request to safeguard evaluation while PO & security review complete
message_1_subject: Eval window at risk — procurement & security review
message_1_body:
Hi Rishi,

Quick note from my side — our procurement team has pulled the PO for the Redwood pilot into an extended security review after a vendor questionnaire flagged a few questions. Procurement says a formal PO should be routed, but timing is unclear and could be 7–14 business days. We27re mid-demo and the team is actively evaluating the latency/cost reports; losing the sandbox now would jeopardize momentum.

Is there a way Redwood can keep the evaluation active (or extend the timer) while procurement completes the review? Even a short-term token top-up or a soft pause on the trial countdown would help us keep engineers engaged. If helpful, I can loop procurement (procure@veridian.ai) into this thread and share the current questionnaire PDF (attached).

Thanks — appreciate the help,
Rajiv
Rajiv Shah
Director, Platform Engineering
Veridian Health

Attachment: Veridian_PO_status.pdf (summary of procurement status)
message_2_subject: Re: Eval window at risk — procurement & security review
message_2_body:
Hi Rajiv —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the attachment. Sorry to hear procurement pulled the PO into a deeper review. We27re happy to help keep the demo live so your team can finish the evaluation.

Proposal from my side:
- We can provision a 10-calendar-day extension to the current eval window (no interrupt).
- Additionally, I can authorize a short-term $750 credit package to keep test runs and integration smoke-tests running while procurement completes the review.

Conditions: we27d just need a note of intent / acknowledgement that Veridian intends to submit a PO and an ETA for when procurement expects to route the PO (even a date range is fine). If you27d prefer, we can send a one-page acknowledgement DocuSign (no legal terms, just an intent-to-purchase note) that your procurement team can sign to formalize the temporary support.

I27ve looped Monica (CS) to monitor usage and ensure the environment stays performant while extended. Monica — can you watch the token burn and reach out if we need to scale anything?

I27m attaching a short Temporary_Credit_Authorization.pdf for internal records. If this works, reply with the expected PO ETA and I27ll push the extension and credits live today.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: Temporary_Credit_Authorization.pdf (internal approval code: RDW-PA-7892)
message_3_subject: Re: Eval window at risk — procurement & security review
message_3_body:
Thanks, Rishi — that sounds very fair and helpful.

Procurement27s current read: they27re prioritizing the checklist but an external security vendor interview pushed our timeline. Best-case we27re at PO submission in ~10 business days; worst-case might be closer to 3 weeks. I27ll be blunt — keeping the environment warm for two weeks would be ideal.

I27ve CC27d procurement to this thread so they have full visibility. Procurement: if you need any additional artifacts from Redwood other than the questionnaire (SOC2 attestation, SIEM summary), Rishi please advise and Rajiv will connect us.

We can sign the acknowledgement DocuSign if that helps accelerate the support. Please go ahead and provision whatever you can for 14 days if possible; if not, 10 days + the $750 credit would be acceptable.

Appreciate the quick help — engineers will be relieved.

—Rajiv
Rajiv Shah
Director, Platform Engineering
Veridian Health
procure@veridian.ai (procurement)
message_4_subject: Re: Eval window at risk — procurement & security review (approved)
message_4_body:
Rajiv / procurement team —

Good news: I cleared this with our sales ops and security liaison and we have approval to do the following immediately: 

1) A 14-calendar-day extension of the evaluation timer (no interruption).
2) A temporary credit grant of $1,000 to the sandbox project (to cover CI runs and integration tests).

We27ve added a short DocuSign acknowledgement for Veridian to sign (no binding procurement terms — just an acknowledgement of intent). Please sign here: https://www.docusign.com/temporary-ack/VER-2384 — once signed we27ll note the acknowledgement on the account record. If procurement prefers, we can accept an email confirmation from an authorized purchasing contact instead.

Monica will keep an eye on usage and ping if the credit burn approaches the grant. Markus — looping you for visibility on the approval code RDW-PA-7892.

Rajiv, I27ll push the extension and credits by end of day. If procurement needs SOC2 artifacts or a short security one-pager, cc me and I27ll coordinate an immediate delivery.

Cheers — and good luck with the security review.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
